same_size_control.pre_registered_expectation: If the cross-sex gap is sex-specific, male->male generalization drop will be substantially smaller than the ~5-point cross-sex gap. If male->male drops comparably, the cross-sex gap is mostly sample-size/distribution-shift, not sex -- in which case this control OVERTURNS the sex interpretation and the representational 'not used' story stands cleaner. This control CAN falsify the behavioral sex claim; written before looking.
same_size_control.decision_rule: male gap << cross-sex gap -> sex-specific, behavioral sex claim survives its strongest control. male gap ~= cross-sex gap -> gap is sample-size/shift, not sex; behavioral sex claim overturned, reported loudly. Operationalized here as: |male_gap| < 0.5*|female_gap| -> survives; |male_gap| >= 0.8*|female_gap| -> overturned; else ambiguous.
same_size_control.confound_note: None needed: the 9 held-out males are the SI regime's OWN test fold, genuinely held out from BOTH the male-subset model and the SI baseline by construction.

cnn1d.text: Male->male gap is much smaller than the cross-sex female gap (male gap=-0.0290 vs female gap=-0.0787) -- the cross-sex gap is sex-specific; the behavioral sex claim SURVIVES its strongest control.

spec_cnn2d.text: Male->male gap is much smaller than the cross-sex female gap (male gap=-0.0205 vs female gap=-0.0498) -- the cross-sex gap is sex-specific; the behavioral sex claim SURVIVES its strongest control.

leave_one_out.pre_registered_expectation: If the effect is real, the gap stays negative across (most) rotations; if it flips sign / swings wildly, it is speaker-driven and fragile. Written before looking.
leave_one_out.decision_rule: gaps negative across all rotations -> direction-robust, not a 3-speaker artifact. gaps flip sign / swing -> speaker-driven, fragile, reported as such. NOT pooled into one CI -- reported per rotation, read qualitatively.
leave_one_out.scope_decision: Leave-one-out WITHIN the existing 3 genuinely-held-out female speakers (36,43,47) -- NOT a full 5-fold rotation requiring retrained baselines (that would need 24 new training runs; declined in favour of this cheaper, no-retrain design that reuses every checkpoint already on disk). This means the leave-one-out check tests robustness to WHICH of the fixed 3 women drives the signal, not generalization to a genuinely different held-out female group.
leave_one_out.n_flag: n=3 female test speakers -- within-sample, not a population claim

cnn1d.text: Gap stays negative across all rotations (full-3 + all 3 leave-one-out) -- direction-robust, not a single-speaker artifact, though still n<=3 and NOT better-powered than the original comparison.

spec_cnn2d.text: Gap stays negative across all rotations (full-3 + all 3 leave-one-out) -- direction-robust, not a single-speaker artifact, though still n<=3 and NOT better-powered than the original comparison.

out_of_scope_confirmed_not_run: pooling leave-one-out rotations into one CI
